hero.name: Manik Chaudhary
hero.title: Lead QA Architect | AI-Assisted Test Automation Expert
paragraphs: Passionate Lead QA Architect specializing in building enterprise-grade test automation frameworks and pioneering AI-assisted testing solutions. Experienced in leveraging machine learning and artificial intelligence to power intelligent test case generation, self-healing selectors, and predictive analytics that drive autonomous continuous testing.

Proven track record in strategic technical leadership, resource management, and the orchestration of global cross-functional teams to deliver high-velocity, premium-quality software. Expert in UI, API, database, performance, and cloud-native testing (AWS, Azure) with seamless integration into modern CI/CD pipelines.

about: Over 11+ years of extensive experience in test automation architecture, quality engineering, and technical delivery management, driving software excellence across complex enterprise systems.

Pioneer in designing next-generation, AI-assisted testing frameworks, leveraging machine learning (ML), natural language processing (NLP), and AI model training to orchestrate intelligent test generation, self-healing execution paths, and predictive defect analytics.

Expertise in cloud-native testing and cloud services (AWS, Azure), successfully provisioning scalable virtualized environments, serverless computing, and cloud data platform integrations to support high-throughput automated execution.

Adept in full-stack test automation covering UI, API, Database, and Performance testing, with a proven track record of seamlessly integrating advanced quality gates into CI/CD DevOps pipelines using Jenkins, Azure DevOps, and GitHub Actions.

Skilled in strategic QA planning, delivery governance, and leading cross-functional global teams, effectively fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and technical excellence in Agile and SAFe environments.

Recognized for driving digital transformation by training teams on AI/ML tools, integrating generative AI pair-programming assistants (like GitHub Copilot), and scaling modern DevOps alignment to maximize organizational efficiency.

Collected and analyzed business requirements to design and implement effective solutions.
Contributed to the development of back-end and front-end modules, ensuring functionality, performance, and scalability.
Performed troubleshooting and bug fixing to maintain application stability and improve user experience.

Developed early automation test scripts to reduce manual effort and accelerate testing cycles.

professional.title: Google – GGRC
professional.description: Google GGRC is an open-source framework meticulously designed to streamline Governance, Risk, and Compliance management. By elegantly mapping complex regulations to specific internal controls, it provides organizations with a structured approach to oversight. While currently considered a legacy or archived project, its core architecture remains a sophisticated blueprint for automating audits, tracking risks, and maintaining a robust, transparent compliance posture.

professional.title: Amazon PLOA
professional.description: Amazon PLOA is a comprehensive digital ecosystem designed to streamline and automate Leave of Absence management for its global workforce. By centralizing complex workflows—such as eligibility tracking, benefits integration, and regulatory compliance—it ensures a seamless experience for employees needing extended time away. The platform elegantly bridges the gap between workforce stability and employee well-being, providing a robust framework for managing unpaid leave and health-related benefits at scale.

professional.title: S&P Capital IQ
professional.description: S&P Global engaged EPAM to establish a Talent Centre to deliver software development and testing services for modernizing S&P Ratings' legacy applications and workflows. The project aimed to replace disjointed legacy tools with a unified, cloud-based, and interactive desktop platform, enabling Ratings Analysts to execute workflows efficiently without relying on multiple systems. This modernization improved efficiency, data quality, automation, and reduced Ratings processing turnaround time.

personal.title: AI-Assisted Test Automation Framework
personal.description: A pioneering enterprise-level test automation framework integrated with AI models to achieve autonomous execution, dynamic test data generation, and self-healing script capabilities. Implemented using Python, it incorporates intelligent log analysis, predictive failure modeling, and an adaptive selector healing engine that automatically repairs broken element locators at runtime, substantially reducing test maintenance cycles and accelerating regression pipelines.

personal.title: Agentic AI-Powered Test Data Management (TDM)
personal.description: An agentic, multi-agent Test Data Management (TDM) platform designed to dynamically provision complete, custom test data environments directly from natural language prompts. Built with Python and FastAPI, this system orchestrates specialized AI agents (Lead & Generator Agents) to dynamically compile database structures, spin up schema-compliant FastAPI endpoints, and inject synthetic datasets obeying complex relational constraints. Featuring real-time WebSocket pipeline tracking and an integrated SPA command center, it eliminates manual database provisioning and acts as an autonomous, on-demand data provider for automation suites.

personal.title: Selenium 2.0 - Production UI Testing Framework
personal.description: A highly modular, production-ready UI automation framework engineered with Python and Selenium WebDriver. Implementing the Page Object Model (POM) design pattern, it features automated environment bootstrapping, robust custom waiting utilities to eliminate synchronization flakes, and detailed HTML report generation. The framework is designed for seamless integration into CI/CD quality gates, providing highly parallelizable and stable browser testing execution across multiple platforms.
